task.title: `vulns diff --branch` defaults to working-tree HEAD instead of the selected branch tip
task.body:
`git pkgs vulns diff` has the same branch/ref mismatch that #346 reported for `vulns blame` (fixed in #350) and #354 reported for `vulns exposure` (fixed in #355).

`runVulnsDiff` resolves `--branch` to a database branch, then defaults the comparison refs to the working tree:

```go
fromRef := "HEAD~1"
toRef := refHEAD
if len(args) >= 1 {
    fromRef = args[0]
}
if len(args) >= 2 {
    toRef = args[1]
}
...
branch, err := resolveBranch(db, branchName)
...
fromVulns, err := getVulnsAtRef(repo, db, branch.ID, fromRef, ecosystem, ecosystemFilter)
...
toVulns, err := getVulnsAtRef(repo, db, branch.ID, toRef, ecosystem, ecosystemFilter)
```

(`cmd/vulns.go:1260-1291`)

Running `git pkgs vulns diff --branch feature` while `main` is checked out compares the `feature` branch history at `main~1` and `main`. If those commits are not in `feature`'s `branch_commits` both sides come back empty and the diff is silently blank; if `main` is an ancestor the diff reflects an older pair of snapshots. The no-flag default hits the same case whenever the checked-out branch differs from the database's default tracked branch.

The fix is the same shape as #350/#355 but needs two SHAs: when no positional refs are given, use `branch.LastAnalyzedSHA` for `to` and its parent within `branch_commits` for `from`, going through `getVulnsAtCommit` directly. Explicit positional refs should keep resolving through `getVulnsAtRef` as they do now.

spec: `vulns diff --branch` defaults to working-tree HEAD instead of the selected branch tip
